notes.title: First Development Update
notes.content:
First Development Update
Hello everyone,

This is my first post about the development of the game, and I wanted to share a bit of the process with you. I'm working on it daily to ensure that by the time the game launches, it’s as polished as possible, with minimal bugs and a solid overall experience.

Lately, I’ve been focusing on fixing small issues and implementing feedback-based improvements. While the changes might seem minor, every detail contributes to a better version of the game.

Thank you for following the development. I’ll be sharing more updates soon, so stay tuned.
